segments.comment: A debug Valkyrie level-teleports to D:3, searches once and dies to a wished wand of death, saving bones. bones.c savebones() makes her ghost on her corpse's square and attaches the ghost's monster id to the corpse with obj_attach_mid().

A Priest loads the bones on D:3. restore.c getlev() gives the ghost a new id and reset_oattached_mids() points the corpse's attached id at it. The Priest teleports beside the ghost and zaps a wished wand of undead turning at it: zap.c revive() finds the ghost through the corpse and prints 'Wizard's ghost is suddenly drawn into its former body!'
